bots.title: My bots

bots.no_bots: You don't have any bots yet.
bots.create_modal_desc: Choose a market, then a bot type.
bots.catalog_grid_futures_desc: Averaging order grid: one size or a mixed grid
bots.catalog_anti_martingale_futures_desc: Breakout entry, trend add-ons, trailing stop
bots.public_subtitle: Grid bots, DCA strategies, and exchange integrations — create and manage algorithmic bots after a quick sign-up.
bots.public_about_desc: Bots execute your strategy 24/7 on the exchange: place grid orders, track positions, and react to market moves without manual clicks.
bots.public_capability_1: Grid Futures on Binance and OKX
bots.public_capability_2: Start, stop, and close bots from the dashboard
bots.public_exchanges_desc: Connect API keys from supported exchanges. More integrations are on the roadmap.
bots.public_soon_telegram_desc: Push notifications for fills, errors, and bot lifecycle events.
bots.public_soon_history_desc: Detailed PnL charts, trade breakdowns, and export.
bots.public_soon_liquidation_desc: Portfolio-wide liquidation monitoring across all bots.
bots.public_soon_ws_desc: Real-time order and position updates in the browser.
bots.public_cta_desc: Create an account, add API keys, and launch your first bot in minutes.
bots.create_engine_warning: Bot was saved, but the exchange returned an error: {error}
bots.no_api_keys: Add an exchange API key before creating a bot.
bots.order_size_hint_notional: The amount is the order's notional value (quantity × price), not margin. Margin = notional / leverage.
bots.order_size_hint_rounding: Quantity is calculated from each order's price and rounded down to the exchange step, so an order never exceeds your amount. If the amount is below the exchange minimum for the entry or for any grid level, the bot will not be created.
bots.order_size_hint_levels: Level amounts grow with the volume mode: entry = your amount, then ×2, ×3, … (linear) or ×2, ×4, … (exponential). In fixed mode every order uses the same amount.
bots.order_size_hint_percent: Entry amount = this percentage of your free USDT balance when the first order is placed. The resulting USDT amount stays fixed until the grid restarts and then works like the “In USDT” mode. It is notional, so with leverage it can be above 100%.
bots.field_orders_hint: How much to add and at what price rise from the cycle start. Row 1 always opens on the breakout signal.
bots.am_advanced_settings_hint: Defaults match the strategy spec. Leave blank to use them.
bots.error_orders_trigger_order: Each next price rise must be greater than the previous one
bots.error_orders_size_percent: Every row needs a % of balance greater than 0
bots.error_ema_order: Fast EMA period must be less than slow EMA period
bots.error_symbol_duplicate_am: You already have an anti-martingale bot for this pair
bots.take_profit_unit_hint: Click to set the threshold in USDT
bots.take_profit_hint_how: After the position opens, the bot places one limit order for the full size — close-only. For a long this is a sell above the average entry; for a short, a buy below. When a grid level fills, take-profit is replaced for the new average entry and the whole position.
bots.take_profit_hint_restart: If take-profit fills and the position is closed, the bot stops unless auto-restart is on. With auto-restart, the grid is placed again.
bots.take_profit_edit_desc: Closes the position automatically with a limit order. The engine places the order on the exchange — this form only saves the setting.
bots.error_take_profit_required: Enter a take-profit value greater than zero
bots.error_take_profit_xor: Set only one threshold: percent or USDT amount
bots.stop_loss_hint_how: The stop appears on the exchange only after every grid order has filled. The percent is from the last grid level, not average entry and not ROE. For a long the stop is below the last order; for a short, above.
bots.stop_loss_hint_restart: If the stop fills, the bot disappears from the list and the grid does not restart. Auto-restart does not apply to stop-loss.
bots.stop_loss_hint_telegram: If Telegram is linked, you will get a message. This is not take-profit and not the profit alert in settings.
bots.stop_loss_removed_toast: Bot closed by stop-loss and removed from tracking
bots.stop_loss_not_found: This bot is not in the list. After stop-loss it is removed from tracking — history is still available.
bots.stop_loss_edit_desc: Protective close after all grid levels fill. The engine places a STOP_MARKET on the exchange — this form only saves the setting. After it fills, the bot leaves the list and the grid does not restart.
bots.error_stop_loss_required: Enter a stop-loss value greater than zero
bots.error_order_size_positive: Enter an order size greater than zero
bots.error_order_size_percent_max: The balance percentage cannot be above 1000
bots.error_order_size_invalid: The order size was rejected. Use one number greater than zero that is not below the exchange minimum.
bots.error_grid_orders: Grid orders count must be between 1 and 500
bots.error_current_price: Current price must be greater than 0
bots.error_total_balance: Total balance must be greater than 0
bots.liquidation_start_price_hint: Optional anchor price; otherwise current price or Binance ticker is used
bots.liquidation_section_desc: Estimate average entry, liquidation price, and total size if the full grid is filled. Does not create a bot.
bots.field_current_price_hint: Used when start price is empty; otherwise the backend uses Binance ticker
bots.field_total_balance_hint: Available USDT margin for the full grid check
bots.event_history_subtitle: Live bot journal: start, stop, close, grid rebuild, order fills
bots.event_history_clear_confirm_filtered: Delete events for the selected period / exchange / bot?
bots.event_history_clear_confirm_all: Delete the entire history of all bots? This cannot be undone.
bots.mixed_deposit_hint: Capital allocated to this bot. Percentages use the deposit fixed before the first order of a cycle; after the position is fully closed it is updated with realized PnL, fees and funding.
bots.mixed_cycle_running: Cycle running: base deposit {deposit} USDT, grid {total} USDT. Changes apply from the next cycle.
bots.mixed_next_deposit: Deposit for the next cycle: {deposit} USDT
bots.mixed_start_order_hint: The order after the fixed ones
bots.mixed_step_hint: Distance to the next order; empty uses the default step
bots.mixed_progression_hint: The progression never changes orders before its start. Any order in the table can be edited by hand; applying the progression again overwrites manual edits.
bots.mixed_notional_hint: Size is position notional, not margin: leverage does not multiply it. Quantity is rounded by exchange rules.
bots.mixed_minimum_hint: If an order is below the exchange minimum, the bot shows an error and never raises the amount itself.
bots.mixed_error_fixed_count: Fixed order count must be a whole number from 0
bots.mixed_error_orders_count: Total orders must be between 2 and {max}
bots.mixed_error_fixed_too_many: More fixed orders than total orders
bots.mixed_error_fixed_usdt: Enter a fixed order amount greater than 0
bots.mixed_error_start_value: Enter a start value greater than 0
bots.mixed_error_step: Enter a price step greater than 0
bots.mixed_error_order_size: Order #{number}: enter a size greater than 0
bots.mixed_error_order_step: Order #{number}: price step must be greater than 0
bots.mixed_edit_desc: Order sizes in USDT or % of deposit, fixed starting orders and progression.
bots.mixed_edit_next_cycle: A cycle is running: placed orders are not recalculated, new settings apply from the next cycle.
bots.liquidation_mixed_note: Mixed grid: {count} orders from a {deposit} USDT deposit, sizes come from the order table.
bots.creation_history_hint: Use «Copy settings» to fill the form from a past attempt. Change anything and submit.
bots.creation_history_empty_type: No creation attempts for this bot type yet.
bots.creation_history_clone_error: Could not restore settings from this entry
bots.creation_history_cloned: Form filled from history. Review and submit.
bots.action_stop_hint: Cancels exchange orders and sets status to Stopped. Does not close positions.
bots.action_close_hint: Cancels orders and closes positions on the exchange. Bot becomes Closed.
bots.action_redeploy_hint: Cancels the current grid and places it again (Grid Futures only).
bots.action_remove_hint: Hides the bot from the list. For active bots, tries to cancel orders first.
bots.help_description: What the actions in the card’s ⋯ menu and on the bot page do, and how to create a bot.
bots.help_action_stop: Stops the bot: orders are cancelled, positions stay open.
bots.help_action_close: Fully ends the bot: orders are cancelled and positions are closed on the exchange.
bots.help_action_redeploy: Rebuilds the order grid with current settings. Available for active Grid Futures bots.
bots.help_action_take_profit: Take-profit is set on the bot: a percent of entry price or a USDT profit target. The bot places a close-only limit order itself. This is not the Telegram profit alert.
bots.help_action_stop_loss: Stop-loss is set on the bot: a percent from the last grid level price. The exchange order is placed only after all grid levels fill. After it fills, the bot leaves the list and auto-restart does not apply. If Telegram is linked, you will get a message. This is not take-profit and not the profit alert.
bots.help_action_remove: Hides the bot from the list. If it is still active, the system first tries to cancel orders.
bots.help_create_step_1: Add an exchange API key in settings — required before creating a bot.
bots.help_create_step_2: Choose the pair, direction, order size (in coin or in USDT), grid step, number of orders, and optional take-profit and stop-loss.
bots.help_create_step_3: Optionally estimate liquidation before launch — this does not create a bot.
bots.help_create_step_4: Click Create bot — it appears in the list and starts trading on the exchange.
bots.confirm_close: Close bot {symbol}? Positions will be closed on the exchange.
bots.confirm_redeploy: Redeploy grid for {symbol}? Orders will be cancelled and the grid will be placed again.
bots.bulk_confirm_stop_all_message: Orders will be cancelled on the exchange for every active bot. Bots will move to stopped status.
bots.bulk_confirm_close_all_message: Every bot that is not closed will have orders cancelled and positions closed on the exchange.
bots.bulk_confirm_remove_all_message: All bots will be hidden from the list. Active bots will attempt to cancel orders first.
bots.chart_keyboard_hint: Left and right arrows pick a candle, with Shift by 10. Home and End jump to the first and last candle, Escape clears.
bots.detail_config_version_hint: Grows when settings change, the grid is redeployed and with every new anti-martingale cycle
bots.position_frozen: The bot is not active: data as of the stop
bots.position_roe_hint: Return on margin as reported by the exchange
bots.position_take_profit_hint: Take-profit price from the average entry, as the bot calculates it
bots.position_none_closed: The bot is closed, no position.
bots.position_none_stopped: The bot is stopped, no position.
bots.position_none_waiting: No position: the bot is waiting for a breakout.
bots.am_chart_empty: The exchange has not returned candles yet. The chart appears after the next update.
bots.am_entry_rule: The bot enters when a 15-minute candle closes above the breakout level and EMA {fast} is above EMA {slow}.
bots.am_window_incomplete: The exchange returned {have} of {need} candles, so the level may differ from the one the bot sees.
bots.am_ladder_hint: No cycle is open. After the breakout entry, the other orders are placed relative to the first entry price.
bots.am_highest_hint: From closed 15-minute candles of the last 25 hours and the mark price. The bot uses 1-minute candles, so this is an estimate
bots.am_trailing_hint: High since entry minus the trailing stop percent. This is an estimate
bots.am_approx_hint: ≈ marks estimates: add-on and trailing stop prices are not reported and the entry fill is not always logged, so the page derives them from candles and the bot’s events.
bots.am_cycles_partial: showing {shown} of {total}: older events are not loaded
bots.am_cycles_hint: Exit is the trailing stop trigger price; on a sharp move the actual fill can differ. Change is the exit against the first entry. Realized PnL per cycle is not available.
bots.grid_anchor_hint: Price the grid levels of this cycle are calculated from
bots.grid_orders_hint: Prices and quantities are fixed at the start of the cycle; the entry price is the one the size was calculated at.
bots.grid_source_estimate: Estimated from orders: the exchange returned no income data
bots.grid_source_note: result estimated from orders or not reported by the exchange.
bots.am_orders_cancelled: The bot is not active: stopping it cancelled the add-on and trailing stop orders, so nothing protects the position now.
bots.am_ema_hint: EMAs here use the {have} candles on this page while the bot uses a longer history, so values right at a crossover can differ.
bots.catalog_trend_futures_desc: Follows the trend: picks long or short itself, enters on a channel breakout, exchange stop, pyramiding
bots.trend_state_empty: The bot has not reported its strategy state yet. It appears after the first engine tick.
bots.trend_cooldown_until: Cooldown after a stop: no new entries until {until}.
bots.trend_position_none: No position: the bot is waiting for a trend and a channel breakout.
bots.trend_load_error: Failed to load trend bot data
bots.trend_reason_warmup: Warming up: not enough candle history
bots.trend_reason_no_regime: No regime: the EMAs are equal
bots.trend_reason_no_breakout: {side} regime, no breakout: {distance_pct} to the level {level}
bots.trend_reason_volume_low: Breakout without volume: {ratio}× with a {volume_mult}× threshold
bots.trend_reason_cooldown: Cooldown after a stop: {remaining} more candles
bots.trend_reason_breakout: Breakout, entering {side}: close {close} beyond the level {level}, ADX {adx}
bots.trend_reason_channel: Channel exit: close {close} beyond the level {level}
bots.trend_reason_position_exists: The exchange already has another position on this pair ({side}, {size}), entry blocked
bots.trend_reason_stale_signal: Stale signal: the engine saw the candle {delay_min} min late
bots.trend_reason_order_failed: The entry order did not fill on the exchange: this candle's breakout is skipped
bots.trend_reason_not_started: The bot was just created: decisions start with the next candle
bots.trend_form_intro: The bot trades one pair and picks the side itself: long while the fast EMA is above the slow one on the higher timeframe, short while it is below. It enters on a channel breakout by a closed candle and places the stop on the exchange right away.
bots.trend_field_close_on_stop: Close the position when the bot is stopped
bots.trend_hint_risk_per_unit_pct: Share of the capital lost if one unit's stop is hit. Above 0, up to 10.
bots.trend_hint_max_units: The first entry plus pyramid adds, 1–10. 1 means no pyramiding.
bots.trend_hint_capital_usdt: Base for the risk and limits. Empty means the account USDT balance at start; then it follows the bot's realized PnL.
bots.trend_hint_exchange_leverage: The bot sets it on the exchange itself (cross), 1–125.
bots.trend_hint_max_notional_x: Position notional stays within this multiple of the capital; an add above the cap is cut.
bots.trend_hint_close_on_stop: Otherwise the position stays on the exchange with its stop order.
bots.trend_hint_signal_timeframe: Candles for entries, exits, ATR and the cooldown.
bots.trend_hint_trend_timeframe: Candles for the EMAs and ADX. Must be longer than the signal timeframe.
bots.trend_hint_adx_min: ADX below the threshold is a sideways market: no new entries.
bots.trend_hint_donchian_entry: Enter when the close is above the high (long) or below the low (short) of the previous N candles.
bots.trend_hint_donchian_exit: Exit when the close breaks the N-candle channel against the position.
bots.trend_hint_volume_mult: The breakout candle volume must be at least this multiple of the average. 0 turns the filter off.
bots.trend_hint_stop_atr: The stop order is placed this far from the entry.
bots.trend_hint_add_step_atr: Add the same size every N ATR in the profitable direction.
bots.trend_hint_trail_atr: The stop follows the extreme since the entry at this distance, only towards profit.
bots.trend_hint_cooldown_bars: Candles without entries after a stop-out.
bots.trend_hint_daily_stop_pct: Loss within a UTC day versus the capital at its start: close and wait for the next day. 0 turns it off.
bots.trend_hint_monthly_stop_pct: The same for a UTC calendar month. 0 turns it off.
bots.trend_hint_exit_on_regime_flip: Close the position when the fast EMA crosses the slow one against it.
bots.trend_error_exchange: The trend bot works with Binance and OKX only.
bots.trend_error_symbol_duplicate: There is already an open bot on this pair with this API key: they would share one exchange position.
bots.trend_error_risk_required: Enter the risk per unit or pick a preset.
bots.trend_error_positive: “{field}”: the value must be greater than 0.
bots.trend_error_timeframes: The regime timeframe must be longer than the signal timeframe.
bots.trend_badge_idle: Enter a pair to see its current trend.
bots.trend_badge_invalid_symbol: Enter the full USDT pair, e.g. BTCUSDT.
bots.trend_badge_unsupported: The trend is available for Binance and OKX only.
bots.trend_badge_error: Failed to get the pair trend
bots.trend_badge_sideways: Sideways market, the bot will wait
bots.trend_chart_aria: {symbol} candlestick chart of the trend bot
bots.trend_chart_hint: EMA {fast}/{slow} are computed on {tf} candles and drawn as steps. Dashed lines are the channels: entry on a {entry}-candle breakout, exit on {exit} candles against the position.
bots.trend_stats_profit_factor_hint: Sum of profits divided by the sum of losses
bots.trend_stats_drawdown_hint: From the capital peak: starting capital plus the accumulated PnL of closed trades
bots.trend_stats_costs_hint: Fees and funding as a percentage of the sum of absolute trade PnL
bots.trend_trades_hint: One row is one position with all its adds. PnL is after fees and funding; R is the result in risks of the first unit.
bots.trend_decisions_hint: The decision on every closed candle: why the bot entered or did not.
bots.trend_decisions_empty: No decisions yet: the first one appears after the next candle closes.
bots.trend_decisions_only_hold: All recent decisions are “holding the position”.
bots.dca_form_intro: The bot buys the coin at market, places limit safety buys below right away and sells everything with one take profit from the average price. The deeper the price falls, the lower the average and the closer the exit in profit.
bots.dca_notice_permission: The API key needs spot trading permission (Spot & Margin Trading on Binance, Trade on OKX).
bots.dca_notice_own_coins: The bot only sells coins it bought itself. Other coins on the account are left alone.
bots.dca_notice_balance: The spot account needs at least as much free USDT as all orders of one cycle.
bots.dca_no_spot_keys: No Binance or OKX API keys: spot DCA works with these exchanges only.
bots.dca_field_auto_restart: Start a new cycle after take profit
bots.dca_hint_safety_order: Size of the first safety order.
bots.dca_hint_deviation: Drop from the entry price to the first safety order.
bots.dca_hint_step_scale: Each next step is this many times the previous one. 1 means equal steps.
bots.dca_hint_volume_scale: Each next order is this many times the previous one. 1 means equal orders.
bots.dca_hint_take_profit: Rise from the average buy price.
bots.dca_hint_trailing: How far the price must pull back from its high for the bot to sell.
bots.dca_hint_stop_loss: If the price falls this far below the average, the bot cancels its orders, sells the coins at market and stops.
bots.dca_hint_auto_restart: Otherwise the bot stops after the sale.
bots.dca_tp_fixed_hint: A limit sell of all coins rests on the exchange and is re-placed after every filled safety order.
bots.dca_tp_trailing_hint: Once the price reaches the take profit, the bot tracks the high and sells at market on a pullback. It never sells below the average price.
bots.dca_preview_empty: Fill in the order sizes and the step to see the ladder.
bots.dca_preview_price_idle: Prices appear once a USDT pair is set.
bots.dca_preview_price_error: Could not load the price: deviations are shown in %.
bots.dca_preview_hint_price: Prices are from the current one: the bot builds the ladder from the actual base order fill and rounds prices and {coin} amounts to the pair's step. Fees are not included.
bots.dca_preview_hint_relative: Deviations and the take profit are from the base order price. Fees are not included.
bots.dca_warning_small_order: Some orders are below {min} USDT: the exchange may reject them. The bot checks the pair's exact minimum on create.
bots.dca_warning_stop_before_safety: The stop loss fires before safety order #{n} fills: deeper orders will never be used.
bots.dca_warning_trailing_wide: The trailing distance is not smaller than the take profit: the sale may happen close to the average price.
bots.dca_error_range_exclusive: “{field}” must be greater than {min} and at most {max}.
bots.dca_error_range_below: “{field}” must be greater than {min} and less than {max}.
bots.dca_error_depth: The last safety order would be {value} below the entry. Lower the step, the step scale or the number of orders.
bots.dca_error_symbol: Spot DCA trades USDT pairs only, e.g. BTCUSDT.
bots.dca_error_exchange: Spot DCA works with Binance and OKX only.
bots.dca_phase_starting_note: The bot buys the base order as soon as there is enough USDT.
bots.dca_state_empty: No cycle data yet: it appears after the bot's first pass.
bots.dca_ladder_hint_cycle: Prices are from the base order price of the current cycle, not rounded to the pair's step.
bots.dca_ladder_hint_planned: Ladder from the settings: prices appear once the bot buys the base order.
bots.dca_position_none: No coins: the bot is waiting to buy the base order.
bots.dca_tp_reason_missing: The order was missing on the exchange — placed again
bots.dca_tp_reason_canceled_on_exchange: The order was canceled on the exchange — placed again
bots.dca_tp_reason_partial_exit_remainder: The previous take profit did not cover all coins (a safety order filled after it) — placed for the rest
bots.dca_confirm_close: Close {symbol}? The bot cancels its orders and sells the coins it bought at market.
bots.dca_action_stop_hint: Cancels the bot's orders and marks it stopped. The coins it bought stay on the account.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.subtitle: Connect and manage exchanges
exchanges.binance_desc: Largest crypto exchange by volume. Futures and spot trading, high liquidity.
exchanges.bybit_desc: Derivatives exchange focused on futures and perpetual contracts. Low fees.
exchanges.okx_desc: Multi-functional exchange with spot, futures, and options. API support.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Profile and account security
settings.email_readonly_hint: Email cannot be changed. Contact support if you need to update it.
